how.title: How to play
how.s1: Choose your bet. The − and + buttons change the bet by one step; tapping the bet amount opens every step. “{max}” picks the highest step your balance covers.
how.s2: Spin. Press the storm button or use the space bar. The round cost ({multiple} times the bet when Chance ×2 is on) is taken from your balance once.
how.s3: Match. On the 6 column × 5 row grid you win when there are 8 or more of the same symbol anywhere; the more there are, the higher the pay tier.
how.s4: Chain. Winning stones shatter, the ones above fall and new stones fill the gaps. This continues until there are no new wins.
how.s5: Lightning. When the chain ends with a win, Tarhun strikes every Storm Stone on the grid; the stone values are summed and the win is multiplied by that total.
how.s6: Result. The whole round is decided by the engine before the spin starts; the animation only plays that result back. The Spin button stays locked until the round (every tumble and free spin) has finished; use the {quick}/{turbo} setting to speed things up. Speed settings, tapping the celebration counter, a hidden tab or leaving the page never change the payout; the round always closes once, with the engine’s payout.
how.note: DEMO credit has no value; it does not earn SOL, tokens or rewards. The game runs in the browser with local randomness; there is no VRF proof.

pay.title: Paytable
pay.lead: You win with 8 or more of the same symbol anywhere on the grid. The large figure is the gross DEMO amount at a bet of {bet}; the multiplier below it is a multiple of the bet.
pay.scatterText: When the base spin ends, 4 or more seals on the grid pay and unlock {spins} free spins. Seals do not burst.
pay.orbText: Carries a value from ×2 to ×500 and can land in both the base game and free spins. It does not burst; it stays in place and slides during tumbles. Details are on the “{features}” page.
pay.maxText: At this bet that is {amount}. If the round total reaches this cap the round ends immediately; remaining free spins are not played.

features.title: Features
features.tumbleText: After every win the winning stones shatter, the rest slide down and the gaps fill from above. The win meter never resets during a round: tumbles, multipliers and all free spins add up in the same total.
features.orbText: Can land in the base game and in free spins; its value is between ×2 and ×500. In the base game, if the tumble chain of a spin ends with a win, the values of the stones on the grid are summed and that spin’s win is multiplied by the total (the seal payout is not multiplied). With no win, the stones have no effect.
features.totalText: Free spins start with a ×0 total multiplier. On every winning spin the Storm Stone values on the grid are added to the total multiplier, then that spin’s win is multiplied by the new total (×1 if the total is still 0). On a spin with no win the stones are not added. The total multiplier is kept throughout the free spins, extra spins included.
features.sealText: When a base spin ends, 4 or more seals pay and unlock {trigger} free spins. In free spins, 3 or more seals add {retrigger} more spins (no payout). A single round awards at most {max} free spins.
features.freeText: Free spins are played at the same bet within the same round; no extra fee is charged. They always end with the “{screen}” screen: spins played, final total multiplier and total win.
features.tiersText: When the round total is 10× your base bet or more, the celebration screen opens and the counter climbs through the tiers: {big} ≥10×, {mega} ≥25×, {super} ≥50×, {epic} ≥100×; a round that reaches the cap ends with {max}. Every applied multiplier is announced in large type above the grid; at the ×10, ×25, ×50, ×100, ×250 and ×500 thresholds the text and sound grow. Tapping the screen jumps the counter to the result; it never changes the payout.
features.anteText: While on, every spin costs {multiple} times your bet and seals are more likely in the base game: the free-spin chance is roughly double ({ante} / {standard}). Wins are still paid on the base bet. The bonus can’t be bought while it is on.
features.buyText: For 100 times your bet the round starts with at least 4 seals; {spins} free spins are guaranteed. The purchase is made through a confirmation window, runs at a separate RTP ({rtp}) and can’t be used with autoplay.

rtp.title: RTP
rtp.heading: Theoretical return (RTP)
rtp.caption: Theoretical return per mode
rtp.method: A separate simulation of {millions} million rounds for each mode (engine storm-throne-1). RTP is calculated against the amount paid. Hit frequency (base spin): standard {hit}, Chance ×2 {hitAnte}. Volatility (standard deviation in cost units): standard {sdStandard}, buy {sdBuy}.
rtp.note: The simulation is an estimate and is uncertified; because of the heavy tail the confidence interval may be optimistic. Results in a short session can differ greatly from the RTP. DEMO credit has no value.

limits.title: Bet and win limits
limits.maxValue: {n} times the bet · {amount} at this bet
limits.p1: A round that reaches the max win ends immediately; remaining free spins are not played. The payout is always calculated on the base bet, with fractions of a cent rounded down.
limits.p2: Steps and modes your balance can’t cover can’t be selected. A round is a single reservation and a single payout; only one round is played at a time.

keys.title: Keys
keys.heading: Keyboard
keys.spaceText: Starts the spin ({settings} → “{option}”). During a round it doesn’t skip the spin; it only speeds up the free-spin screens and the celebration counter.
keys.escText: Closes the open window (except the session reminder).
keys.tabText: Moves between controls; focus is always visible.
keys.arrowsText: Switches pages in this info window; changes the option in setting choices.
keys.note: The screen reader announces every step (“{example}”, multipliers, the round result); the grid is read as a 6×5 table. Symbols are told apart by shape and marking as well as colour. The reduced-motion preference turns off particles, lightning and shaking.

fault.title: Fault clause
fault.p1: A fault voids all affected games and payouts. In case of a software, browser or device fault the round record is authoritative; an amount that appears on screen but does not match the engine record is not valid.
fault.p2: This game is played with DEMO credit only. DEMO has no value and cannot be converted to money or tokens; in case of a fault the DEMO balance and session history may be corrected or reset.
fault.p3: Because the result is decided before the spin, an animation that is cut short, a hidden tab or leaving the page does not change the result; the round still closes once with the engine’s payout.
